about_the_game:
❗❗Warning: This game is a small indie title developed by only two people and is priced at just $5.99. Please do not expect it to reach the level of a AAA blockbuster. We have done our best as a two-person team to complete this project, and we invite you to experience this mountain-climbing journey with a calm and open mind.

●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●

World's first life-size 1:1 replica of Everest in a game. Climbing Mount Everest is a lifelong dream for many — but also the world’s most dangerous and costly challenge. Now, with this game, you can live that dream without risking your life or breaking the bank!

Based on satellite mapping

EVEREST: Real Climbing Simulator is The world’s first 1:1 Mount Everest climbing game based on satellite mapping.

Two Modes

  • ⭐ Reality Mode — Experience the true challenge of trekking and climbing.

  • ⭐ Entertainment Mode — For players who want to enjoy Everest’s scenery more easily, snowmobiles are added for a fun and fast way to cross dangerous areas.

Your Goal

Climb Mount Everest — the 8,848-meter Roof of the World.
Feel free to record and share your climbing route with other users, and compete for the best climbing records.

From the Developers

The trailer showcases our intended final design goals. At the moment, with our current development capacity, we are not yet able to fully realize all the gameplay shown in the trailer. If you’re interested in collaborating or investing, please feel free to contact us.

funcitysayhello@gmail.com

As for the bears, wolves, and snowmobiles: at first, the game was intended to be a fully realistic Everest climbing simulation. But during testing we realized that, at the true climbing pace, a single ascent would take about 4 real-time days. Very few players could push through 4 days of endless snowfields without anything else happening.

So we decided to add Entertainment Mode with animals and snowmobile, allowing players to complete an ascent in their free time after work.

Of course, you can also choose the Reality Mode, where every single step is taken manually. But be prepared for a very long climb before you reach the summit.

We guarantee that Mount Everest in this game is recreated with 100% accuracy based on satellite mapping. That alone makes it a unique experience. When you finally reach the summit in-game, you will understand the breathtaking scale for yourself.
